senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="O00940">same</cite> <cite ref="Gittin 60b:15">Gitt. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>במִיסְכַּר ואשקויי</he> as to damming (the canal) and using the water for irrigation.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 60b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>סְכַר מיסכר ואשקי וכ׳</he> dam thou the canal, but &c., v. <cite ref="E00659"><he>הַנְדְּזָא</he></cite>
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 21:13">Targ. Prov. XXI, 13</cite>.
Ib. XXVIII, 9 דמְסַכַּר Ms. (ed. מַסְכִּיר Af.).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 109b:7">Sabb. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>נְסַכְּרִינוּן וכ׳</he> let them stop up his orifices (ears and nose).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106b:9">B. Mets. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ נהר מלכא סבא</he> the Old King’s Canal became obstructed (and the waters took a different direction).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>לא עביד דמִסְתַּכַּר</he> Ms. F. a. oth. (ed. <he>דמִיסְּכַר</he>) it is unusual (for this canal) to be obstructed.
